{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The adjustment you made on the backup hyperdrive checks out 100 percent. You did a great job!|[[Tere Metallo]] to [[Matt Turhaya]]|<ref name="Passages">{{JournalCite|7|Passages}}</ref>}}
A '''backup hyperdrive''' was a secondary [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] unit found on most [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Such drives were usually underpowered, slow, and antiquated. Backup hyperdrives had a range of only ten [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]], and after each use, the unit had to be reconditioned in a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] before further use. They were only intended to be used in an emergency situation.<ref name="RPG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
